description: This header file declares functions related to gathering network interface statistics on Linux systems, including interface, VAP (Virtual Access Point), radio, and VLAN stats.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getInterfaceStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specified network interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getVapStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific Virtual Access Point (VAP).

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllVapStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for all VAPs on a given radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllEpStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for all Ethernet points (Ep) on a radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_acculumateUpperVlansStats
methods.description: Aggregates statistics for upper VLANs on a specific interface.
